name: GEC
full_name: GEC — Global Excellence Challenge (an E.A.S.E. programme)
summary: Premium, world-class academic competition brand with the Clocket timed practice app. Prestigious, energetic, precise, global yet personal. Navy dominant, gold accent.

colours.name: GEC Royal Navy
colours.use: Dominant brand colour: backgrounds, headers, primary CTAs

colours.name: Championship Gold
colours.use: Accent: headlines on navy, highlights, dividers, icons, borders. Never small text.

colours.name: Pure White
colours.use: Content background, body text on navy

colours.name: Charcoal
colours.use: Body text on light backgrounds (never pure black)

fonts: Calibri (CSS: font-family: Calibri, Carlito, 'Trebuchet MS', Arial, sans-serif). Monospace for data only: 'Courier New'. Headings 1.1–1.2 line height, body 1.4–1.6. Left-aligned, never justified. Titles on dark backgrounds: white or gold only.
hard_rules: First mention: "Global Excellence Challenge", then "GEC". Never "Global Excellence" or "GEC Challenge".
The app is "Clocket" exactly — never clocket, CLOCKET or The Clocket App.
Participants are "Mathletes" (or Spell Bees, Young Scientists etc.) — avoid students/kids/participants in copy.
Rounds are Qualifier, Semi-Final, Grand Final — never Round 1 / Stage 1 / Level 1.
Default social: 1:1 square, navy background, gold headline, white body text. Always include the GEC or Clocket logo.
Never introduce colours outside the palette. Never use gold as small text.
Logo: never stretch, recolour, rotate or add shadows/outlines/effects; never on busy or low-contrast backgrounds; clear space at least the height of the G; minimum 80px wide on screen.
Voice: authoritative, energetic, inclusive, precise; encouraging, direct, celebratory, motivating. Never intimidating, elitist, vague, overly casual or boastful.
Avoid making every post look like a school advertisement or textbook illustration — exciting, modern, inspiring educational marketing.

logos.note: Primary GEC logo (globe + open book, GEC wordmark with clock in the E, 'GLOBAL EXCELLENCE CHALLENGE'). IMPORTANT: it has a solid WHITE background baked in (not transparent), aspect ~1.12:1. On navy layouts, place it inside a clean white badge/panel (rounded rectangle or circle with generous padding) — never let a white box look accidental. Recommended width 180–300px.

Clocket app logo (gold stopwatch, navy face, 'CLOCKET Your GEC Practice App'). Solid WHITE background baked in, aspect ~0.83:1. Same white-badge treatment on dark backgrounds. Use when the post is about practice or the app.
